$comment: DERIVED from plan section 8.5 by scripts/parity-obligations.mjs. Do not edit. The report declares which of its fields discharge each obligation; the judgement of what discharges one belongs with the report, the obligation belongs with the plan.

obligations.sentence: exact implementation, Java reference, and data commit SHAs plus the porting-contract archive digest
the exact `requirements.json` SHA-256, selected release-profile ID, profile-registry SHA-256, selection-record SHA-256, and active release requirement/evidence ID sets
exact `requiredPortableIds`, applicable `requiredImplementationIds`, passed, failed, xfailed, and unsupported ID sets
xfail metadata and deterministic `sourceDateEpoch` derived from the release tag/commit
The report is embedded in the packed npm artifact and attached to the immutable release.
CI verifies byte identity between the tested and published copies.
The strict required partition must show zero failed, xfailed, and unsupported IDs.
`DIVERGENCES.md` is generated from the xfail/unsupported records.
Volatile wall-clock run times remain CI attestation metadata outside the canonical packed report, so they do not defeat reproducible tarballs.
